contract: GET /auth/openid/callback. Validate callback state, issuer, signature, audience, nonce and provider errors before matching/creating an allowed user; preserve web cookies/native redirect and group-derived permission semantics; consume callback state once.

invariants.contract: Web/mobile OIDC start and callback preserve allowed redirect parameters, state/PKCE/nonce binding and client-consumed JWT claims. Required auth cookies retain usable lifetime/Path/HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite semantics; opaque cookie values and the Express session implementation are free if isolation and replay protection hold.
exceptions: Evidence covers selected successful web/mobile callbacks only; invalid-verifier/provider errors, error cookie clearing, logout cookie clearing, and other callback variants remain unverified.

Historical pre-rewrite observation (not a fixed representation requirement): Selected successful web callbacks match cookie names, stable values, Max-Age, Path, Expires, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, signed connect.sid, and JWT algorithms/claims; UUID identifiers and timestamps are compared by semantics, and each OIDC ID-token nonce is bound to its own authorization request.

invariants.contract: Replaying a callback after its state has been consumed returns the upstream no-sign-in-session redirect and creates no additional persisted user/session.

A successful mobile callback accepts the provider code and caller-supplied PKCE verifier, returns the upstream API login payload and token claims, persists one provider-linked active user and one session, and matches the selected user fields and server settings.
exceptions: One local RS256 provider, one allowlisted redirect URI, one S256 flow, and the fixture auto-registration mode are covered. Invalid verifier/provider failures remain unverified.

invariants.contract: Repeating the mobile token-exchange callback after the first callback consumed its session returns HTTP 400 No session with a usable client-visible denial and creates no second user or session.
exceptions: Historical pre-rewrite observation (not a fixed representation requirement): Repeating the mobile token-exchange callback after the first callback consumed its session returns HTTP 400 No session with Express text/html response behavior and creates no second user or session.

invariants.contract: A callback request with no browser session and an empty code_verifier is treated as web and redirects to login with No sign-in session; a truthy code_verifier (non-empty string or repeated-query array) selects the mobile No session response.

A web OIDC callback using the same browser session remains valid after more than ten minutes but before the upstream 24-hour session TTL; callback route/tokens/cookies and provider-linked persisted user/session state match.
exceptions: One callback after 10 minutes with no intervening requests is covered. The exact 24-hour boundary and rolling session-touch renewal remain unverified.
